name: Westfall: a ghost released inside the Deadmines entrance reaches the Dagger Hills Spirit Healer (#7648)
contract: A player who dies inside the Deadmines entrance cave (zone 10135, at the Defias Digger spawn (-11089.5,1531.5,31)) releases at the nearest graveyard of Westfall (40), Dagger Hills 1462 (-11218.7,1711.25,39.0291), instead of the default Westfall graveyard 4 at Sentinel Hill. Its Spirit Healer 6491 stands near it. Death and spirit release use the native handlers.

steps.label: The released player is a ghost
The ghost lands at the Dagger Hills graveyard
A Spirit Healer stands at the ghost's graveyard
